scenario: LINT.6.2 — `i.duration` desugars to `end - start`. Pin: `(m.window_start..m.window_end).duration > 1_s` over Time slots compiles. For Time endpoints `end - start` is a Duration (LTIM.4.1), so comparing it with a duration literal type-checks. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` reads no lowering, so the subtraction is not observed.
rules_ds:

    entity_id: String key
    window_start: Time mutable
    window_end: Time mutable

rule r:
